releaseName: Adaptive Segment Failure Isolation with Task-Level Diagnostics

analysisArchitecture.aiContribution: four parent analysis axes executed as isolated tasks; governance is pre-split and content failures decompose by target batches
analysisArchitecture.reconciliation: incremental field-level merge with parent-count locks, task-level partial success and failed-task-only retry

automaticRecovery.contentFailureHandling: decompose full task by target batches; governance already isolated

acceptanceCoverage.adaptiveFallback: new-form profiling, relevant exploratory analysis, data requests and contract proposal
acceptanceCoverage.scoreReconciliation: exactly 4 diagnostic sections, 5 findings, 4 interventions and 4 monitoring stages
acceptanceCoverage.duplicatePrevention: Gemini cannot create parallel score interventions or monitoring cycles
acceptanceCoverage.invalidTargetHandling: unknown target IDs are rejected before reconciliation
acceptanceCoverage.reportOutput: one reconciled analysis, six print-safe pages for the score fixture
acceptanceCoverage.masteryFixture: 268 valid, 48 mastered, 220 not mastered, 17.91044776119403% raw spread, 17.9% display
acceptanceCoverage.segmentedPipeline: four parent axes represented by five initial isolated tasks; governance quality and monitoring never share one response
acceptanceCoverage.partialFailure: successful tasks remain reconciled; UI names the failed task and reason
acceptanceCoverage.automaticRecovery: content failures are decomposed instead of repeated; only transient failures receive one bounded retry
acceptanceCoverage.nonRetryableFailure: 401/configuration failure is not retried; isolated content failure is surfaced after its server compact attempt

performance.resultsPresentation: deterministic results first, isolated Gemini tasks with max concurrency three, incremental reconciliation
performance.expectedBenefit: no 73-second identical retry loop; smaller governance payloads and exact failed-task diagnosis
performance.cacheGranularity: one cache entry per isolated task
performance.retryGranularity: failed task only; content failures decompose, transient failures retry once
performance.recoveryBackoff: one bounded transient retry with Retry-After support; no repeated identical content payloads

backwardCompatibility.previousFrontend: v0.9.2 segmented clients remain compatible with enrich_segment
